'''Sea-moss''' was a plant native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. Sea-moss grew over the [[flotation collar]] of the abandoned [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] on Sedri.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
